newsitem.title: USA: Clinton expected to name top U.S. military officer.
newsitem.headline: Clinton expected to name top U.S. military officer.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton was scheduled to make an announcement at 8:45 a.m. EDT (1245 GMT) on Thursday, the White House said, and he was widely expected to name Army Gen. Henry Shelton chairman of the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff.
The White House announced Clinton would make a statement in the White House Rose Garden before leaving on a two-day trip to Pennsylvania, Illinois and Arkansas but did not disclose its subject.

Administration officials said on Thursday that Clinton was expected to nominate Shelton, the head of the U.S. Special Operations Command, to replace Army Gen. John Shalikashvili, who is scheduled to step down from the post at the end of September.
Shelton's nomination is subject to approval by the U.S. Senate.
